parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test targets: 'Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift' and 'Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift'. Both carry the name 'MockArtworkService', which is a canonical mock fixture pattern. Per the decision rules, any cluster where a participating record is a test fixture warrants no-action; here both records are test fixtures. Consolidating these mocks would couple two separate test packages (AppServices and Artwork) and risk polluting production dependency graphs with test-only types.
